answer: The thread lists finished tasks with their hashes, and the signal is where a second reviewer recomputes them. The design leans on commit-reveal work receipts, forfeited on duplicate submission, quorum must span unrelated subnetworks. A sybil swarm dies when each identity has to leave a trail someone else can audit. Written in a one long clause plus a short one register, it stays short. What survives to the vault is a record of labour, not a list of addresses.
